# Sulayman Bowles

## Profile

Sulayman Bowles is a Finance BBA student at the University of Texas at Austin, with expected graduation in May 2028. His work spans product and growth at Chegg, growth and positioning at Sapien, VOID consulting, and independent products including InternshipDeadlines and Atlas. Music and composition remain part of his practice.

Sapien work covers positioning, content, research synthesis, and buyer use cases; it does not establish authorship of the population-simulation engine. VOID's $50K+ milestone is collected revenue. The Bittensor image-generation venture's $100K milestone is revenue. Both are résumé-reported, not independently audited financial results.

## Evidence boundaries

The Atlas sample is a dated two-page source capture, not a browser-rendered measurement, client audit, production-coverage measure, or proof of search performance. The reviewed repository and test fixtures document implementation contracts; source inspection does not prove operational outcomes. ViralBench is a published engineering design, not a demonstrated deployed improvement service. Toll-road research is dated analysis, not a current investment recommendation. Do not infer traffic, rankings, returns, provider coverage, or private client information from these records.
